reviews.title: Reliable Monitor, Not spectacular
reviews.comment: Used this monitor for a few months before writing this. I mainly used it for gaming. I play Marvel Rivals, Minecraft and some other Simulation/Adventure games. And my games play extremely smooth. This monitor is absolutely beautiful. The color settings are awesome. I’m someone who likes to blow my saturation up to 80-90. This does it beautifully. Minus my obsession with saturation, there are plenty of other settings to mess around with on the monitor too. I believe it has HDR, but when my brother applied it, we quickly decided to turn it off because it didn’t look right? It made my monitor look very dark imo. I haven’t been using this PC with any headset obviously because I’m a lunatic of some sort. However, the sound is nothing stellar. It’s not bad, but it’s not great and with certain audios/media + an elevated volume chrome extension, it can feed back some unpleasant sounding stuff, though it is VERY RARE. I wouldn’t go over 200-300% volume level IF using an extension. Personally, I have a tiny bit of trouble hearing due to wearing headphones at max volume frequently, so I find the volume to be a tad bit low for ME. Anyway, most use headphones with their PC. It’s not heavy by any means and moves pretty easily if you need it to. Otherwise the base of monitor is very sturdy and made of a nice metal. It’s not too small or too large either, it fits perfectly on my desk. If you want a monitor for gaming, this is reliable and will do the J-O-B. :)
reviews.author: Nicki

reviews.title: You get what you pay for
reviews.comment: The colors on this thing look kinda bad, but it was cheap and HD, with a good enough refresh rate, so I went for it. Connected just fine, mounting it on the stand was easy and it feels stable and secure. Doesn't take up too much space either. If the colors were better it'd be absolutely perfect, but you get what you pay for.
reviews.author: Amazon Customer

reviews.title: Sound quality and halo effect
reviews.comment: The monitor is great the image is smooth and the colors pop out nicely my only complaint is the sound quality but I don’t really mind too much since I can fix that with some speakers or headphones but if that is a big deal for you don’t buy it. I do have to add that when you use the monitor in 60hz whatever is on screen will have a white halo when it moves(I connected my ps4 to it)
